The parties also file a compromise petition / settlement memo seeking permission to compound the offences before this Court.

"6. Koramangala Branch, Bangalore.
It is submitted that the parties herein have amicably settled their dispute the manner as stated supra and further there is no claims and contention between the parties each other and hence the respondent No.2 submits no objection to allow the petition as prayed for in the said petition.
